title: Vaccination with mRNA-encoded nanoparticles drives early maturation of HIV bnAb precursors in humans | Science
content: A leading HIV vaccine strategy requires a priming immunogen to induce broadly neutralizing antibody (bnAb) precursors, followed by a series of heterologous boosters to elicit somatic hypermutation (SHM) and produce bnAbs. In two randomized, open-label ...
